Odbijena formulacija (EN): Observer was right [F3]: Sensor.Community counts 42 instruments with 5396 values in 6 h, but the facts carry no locations. Connector was right: headlines appear without timestamps—[F13] and [F16] lack event dates. But here is what they missed: BVK sent nothing in 6 h [F12], yet the heat headline claims a problem [F13]; Elektrodistribucija sent nothing [F26, F30], yet power cuts are announced [F16]. News reports events; operational feeds are silent.

Odbijena formulacija (EN): Observer's 19 min is stale: parking now shows 16 min since last reception [F4], the same age as the RHMZ automatic stations [F27], while citizen sensors and DanubeHIS both came in 6 min ago [F3][F35] - four live instrument streams around a 6 h hole where SEPA should be [F2]. I agree with Skeptic that 389 to 431 at Obilićev venac carries no measurement time [F5], but the shape of the receptions is itself checkable: two sources at 16 min and two at 6 min looks like shared polling cadence, not a city event. And the three link-ups the organelle rated 5/5 all point at one Blic cable-theft headline [F38][F39][F40][F41] from a source that delivered nothing in 6 h [F25] - the similarity is in the sorter's embedding, not in the city.
